summary.name: ecrett music
summary.one_liner: ecrett music is an AI music generator that creates royalty-free background tracks for games, videos, podcasts and ads based on chosen scene, mood and genre.
use_cases: Adding background music to YouTube videos
Soundtrack for ads or wedding videos
Checking whether music fits a video
summary.what_it_does: Users pick at least one of Scene, Mood and Genre, then click Create Music and the AI generates a track. Each generation differs even with the same settings. Instruments for melody, backing, bass and drum can be changed, and song structure can be adjusted by switching blocks on or off. A top-right area holds Favorites, Download History, a Video tab for checking whether the music fits a video, and a Create History of the past 10 tracks. The page says the music is royalty-free and can be downloaded as is or customized.
notable: Scene, mood and genre based generation with customizable instruments and song structure
Free tier allows previewing and downloading preview music; paid tiers unlock unlimited downloads and commercial use
Video tab to test if generated music matches a video
caveats: Free tier only permits downloading preview music; unlimited royalty-free downloads require a paid license (individual or company)
Music may not be distributed or sold as a standalone music file, even for free, and may not be used for harmful, sexual or hateful content
Ecrett is described as still in development
